integrity: The local count is derived from the published definition and independently exhaustively checked over all 64 local truth sets. The infinite orbit statements use a proof of free amalgamation, not extrapolation from finite data.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to arity three.
The class is explicitly specialized to the irreflexive convention, with R false on repeated-coordinate tuples.
No formula is claimed for higher prime arities.
title: A 48-state local factorization for ternary L-hypertournaments
